title: Wakeari Senpai no Kanojo ni Narimashita
titleRomaji: Wakeari Senpai no Kanojo ni Narimashita
titleNative: 訳アリ先輩の彼女になりました
synopsis: [I met him when I wanted to die.] Miyuki Saga worked part-time at a convenience store. Her eyes were always empty and unmoved. "I want to leave soon..." The person who appeared before her, the local famous yankee, x passive beautiful girl. "I didn't think it would be fun to just go through each day mindlessly." Miyuki was the target of bullying among the class girls. Abandoned to all forms of harassment, abuse and sometimes violence... "to combat them, I went to school automatically, and then I worked part-time at a convenience store. I just wanted to end this loop." However, Miyuki's monochrome daily life changed when she met Onitsuka, the leader of the delinquents. "Sometimes it's hard, but when I'm with this person, the world starts to shine."

title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

title: Seibutsubu no Tanabe-kun
titleNative: せいぶつ部の田辺くん
synopsis: Sakura Kirishima is a flawless beauty who serves as the student council president. She works diligently everyday at the student council, honing her leadership skills with the goal of becoming Prime Minister someday. But then she runs into Seijiro Tanabe, the handsome but eccentric president of the Biology Club. Swept up by his passion for biological study, Sakura is about to experience the predatory side of Seijiro Tanabe's personality! (Source: Magapoke, translated)
